options.npc_answer: I just escaped with: [inventory_list]. You look like you've seen better days too.
Use an Axe or Primitive Axe to chop trees. Wood is life out here.
Search for magazines. Reading keeps the mind from rotting before the body does. Take this, it may help you.
For our lucky the company made all vehicle keys the same. Here is a gift.

options.player_question: Did you get any news from the continent?
options.npc_answer: Here was the last place to fall apart. If we get lucky we could clean up the island.
Fully functional for years. I miss my family so much.
They say it was the first to fall. Total chaos. Glad I was out here when the world ended.
Just rogues, some military and the infected. If it moves and doesn't scream 'don't shoot', it's probably trying to kill you.
Maybe you can finish my misery.
Stop bothering me before I lose my temper. Every man for himself, remember?
